unit: NOK bn, calendar years; + adds to the general government deficit (lowers the surplus)
note: Norway budgets one year at a time: no budget after 2026 is law, so the 2026 loosening is held at its 2026 level, except the temporary fuel duty cut, which ends in 2026.

items.label: Temporary fuel duty cut (April to 1 September 2026)
items.head: tax
items.source: Meld. St. 2 (2025-2026), chapter 3: NOK 5.5bn in 2026; the cut is temporary, reversed on 1 September 2026 (Altinget, citing the Ministry of Finance); Storting recommendation Innst. 450 S (2025-2026)

items.label: Other 2026 budget loosening (budget impulse)
items.head: spend
items.source: Meld. St. 2 (2025-2026), chapter 3: budget impulse 0.9% of mainland trend GDP (NOK 4,599bn) = NOK 41.4bn, less the fuel duty cut
